scheme_name: Loan Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Commercial Pilot Training
other_conditions: The applicant must have passed Matriculation or Higher Secondary School Certificate or an equivalent examination.
The applicant must meet all academic and technical qualifications required by the training institute for Commercial Pilot License training.
A consent letter from the training institute for admission must be obtained.
Cost estimates for the training must be submitted to the authority.
Relatives living abroad cannot sponsor the candidate financially.
Training must commence within one month of loan disbursement.
The beneficiary must render services in India for a minimum period of five years after completing the training.
Two valid sureties must be furnished.
Loan repayment must be completed within 10 years (principal and interest in 2 years, total amount in 12 years) with monthly installments; loan recovery starts after one year from disbursement.
A penal interest of 2.5% per annum will be applied for default in repayment.
benefits_summary: A loan of up to ₹25 lakh is provided at an interest rate of 4 %.
documents_required: Consent letter from the training institute
